title: Stevan Pasero Christopher Bock Songs For The Wild CD Acoustic Guitar Sax
conditionDescription: Pre-owned. Disc, jewel case and inserts show normal light wear consistent with age and storage. Please review photos for exact condition.
descriptionText:
Songs for the Wild - Stevan Pasero with Christopher Bock
(Sugo Recording Co., 1994). Produced by Stevan Pasero,
Christopher Bock and Russell Bond. Made in USA.

Original compositions dedicated to the preservation of endangered
species, featuring acoustic guitar, hypnotic percussion, sax, oboe,
bass and lush instrumentation.

1. Her Flying Horses
2. House of Sun
3. She Lives Inside
4. My Wild Gypsy (Rhumba)
5. Preservation Trance
6. Our Midnight Serenade
7. Dark Eyed Samba
8. Nanigo (African Dream)
9. Danza de Pasion
10. Wild Calm
11. Elements of Balance

Disc, jewel case and pictured inserts are included. You will receive the exact CD pictured.
